page.overview:
Who is Archaeological team?

The archaeological team is a group of characters in Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction. They are located on a site in Canada, where they are excavating the bones of a dinosaur.

The player is able to Duel two of the archaeologists. Of the two, one of them can be Dueled a second time. The ID numbers below are used internally in the game's code.
